name: Yamaga Neko
source:
Yamaga Neko is a vice committee chairman who wear her glass. Disliking any skewing matters, she takes her business seriously when she wants to express her needs. She becomes shy (her weakness) only when she's facing the committee chairman.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://trumple.jp/character.php#tabs-7]official website[/url]]
